lxc_763558e44ec65216.text: Stocks, ETFs, bonds, Treasuries, liquidity, currency, and energy affect investments in different ways.

lxc_12e2b83e82b51c71.text: Use three questions: What do you own, what changed, and what was the result?

lxc_492189bf55a6d3aa.text: A stock is a small ownership interest in a company.

lxc_da987e2102a8cd4e.text: Imagine that Blue Harbor is a fictional company with 50 shares.

lxc_a5000e193abcb7e7.text: If Alex buys one share, Alex owns one small part of the company.

lxc_7a1d3247f2c8fca9.text: The share represents an interest in the company’s assets and profits.

lxc_ad4c5b3a91203628.text: Its market value can rise or fall quickly, so profit is never certain.

lxc_bb9bd800452a0c52.text: Ask three questions: What does Alex own?

lxc_8dea0797c0fc22e8.text: Alex’s investment gained or lost value.

lxc_68c552386c090461.text: An exchange-traded fund, or ETF, collects money from many investors.

lxc_2e918f9842059559.text: It uses that money for a portfolio of stocks, bonds, or other assets.

lxc_20318fef85a13382.text: Each ETF share gives part ownership of the whole portfolio.

lxc_467790c99f60892c.text: For example, an imagined City Basket ETF might hold shares in 50 companies.

lxc_db72bc9eb9b56042.text: A person can buy one ETF share instead of buying every stock separately.

lxc_c099e84b87966244.text: ETF shares trade on an exchange during the day.

lxc_3839db25b0981509.text: Their market price can be a little higher or lower than the value of the assets inside the fund.

lxc_8a291d7896b2a405.text: A bond is a loan from an investor to an issuer.

lxc_8eb3b1f472620eb9.text: The issuer may be a company, city, or government.

lxc_6a2b0ec994efbd7b.text: It usually pays interest and returns the original amount, called the principal, at maturity.

lxc_3ffe0760f817fcce.text: A US Treasury is specifically debt from the US government.

lxc_7e5260d858d1c37e.text: Treasury Notes have terms of 2 to 10 years, and Treasury Bonds can have 20- or 30-year terms.

lxc_4b9992eee49e2cd1.text: Notes and Bonds pay interest every six months.

lxc_910c02c292189034.text: Therefore, every Treasury is government debt, but not every bond is a Treasury.

lxc_e84e0e2bd38db9d1.text: Liquidity means how easily and quickly an investment can be bought or sold in a secondary market.

lxc_204fedbdb4bfbffc.text: A liquid investment can usually be sold when cash is needed without a large fee or a much worse price.

lxc_06ec556fde3ae48b.text: Security A has many ready buyers, so Alex sells it near the expected price.

lxc_c3b1f7a0dc4868fd.text: Alex must wait or accept a lower price.

lxc_4eeee79ff616f99d.text: Liquidity matters because an investment may have value on paper but still be difficult to turn into cash.

lxc_1f9d8cc0fefba8b2.text: Currency can change the result of an international investment.

lxc_f182e2961574554a.text: Consider a simple dollar and euro example.

lxc_6d12d794d96dc9ea.text: Suppose Alex changes $80 into 80 euros when one dollar equals one euro.

lxc_15485311b6ee7a05.text: Later, imagine that one euro equals $1.10.

lxc_720daa31a45980be.text: Alex’s 80 euros are now worth $88 before fees and taxes.

lxc_e6ef475fea073b20.text: If one euro instead equals $0.90, it is worth only $72.

lxc_c60069061b5057d5.text: The investment did not change in euros, but its dollar result changed.

lxc_ffb04aaa3a8bf33c.text: Use the lens again: Alex owned a euro investment, the exchange rate changed, and the dollar value changed.

lxc_b4d4a3c842b9f530.text: Energy can affect investments through business costs and sales.

lxc_f17a98a8bebf3f7d.text: Imagine Bright Air uses fuel for its flights.

lxc_247011de22b02b41.text: If fuel cost for one trip rises from $80 to $95 while ticket income stays the same, its cost rises by $15.

lxc_c3c534494c8e78fa.text: Now imagine Sun Field Energy sells fuel.

lxc_1cf9912271c7fe90.text: A higher selling price may increase its income, although its own costs also matter.

lxc_840ff7389aa70d29.text: A stock ETF could hold both companies, so energy changes may affect different parts of its portfolio differently.

lxc_57a7cdabe111a535.text: These examples show possible effects; they do not promise any investment result.
